name: tidy-agent
description: Daily Desktop/Downloads tidy (~/.claude/organize/tidy_agent.py): files aged items into ~/Documents buckets and rewrites the Desktop map. The venv Python, which holds Full Disk Access on both Macs; /usr/bin/python3 lost it on the Mini (marvin#1123 0.6). The Mini only: both Macs share one iCloud Desktop (PR #1129)
